description: List DataCanvas tables and columns staged by a prior imf_query_dataset call. Returns each table's name, row count, and column schema (name + DuckDB type). Required before imf_dataframe_query to discover the table and column names for SQL.

canvas_id.description: Canvas ID returned by imf_query_dataset whenever staged=true, from automatic spillover or output_mode="canvas".

name: imf_dataframe_describe

canvas_id.description: Canvas session ID that was introspected.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `canvas_not_found`: canvas_id does not match any registered DataCanvas session (expired, wrong session, or canvas disabled). Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

table_count.description: Total number of tables on the canvas.

tables.description: All tables registered on this canvas.

items.description: A single canvas table with its schema.

name.description: Column name — use this in SELECT and WHERE clauses.

type.description: DuckDB column type, e.g. VARCHAR, DOUBLE, BIGINT.

name.description: Table name — use this in imf_dataframe_query SQL.

row_count.description: Number of rows in this table.

title: Imf Dataframe Describe
